description: Reports a problem with Geocode AI: a failing or wrong API call, a wrong or missing boundary, a docs error. Call it after a call fails in a way that looks like our bug (5xx, a wrong polygon, a boundary that should exist), with the failing call's request_id (X-Request-Id header or the error's request_id) and op; add query, boundary_id and the error in context. Issues are private to you and the team. It first returns similar issues you can see, filing nothing; upvote_feedback the same one or pass force: true. Free; needs a key; 10 new items per account a day. The human gets an email with the reference and on every status change. Needs an API key or a connected account.

context.description: What we need to reproduce it. Only you and the team see it.

boundary_id.description: The boundary concerned (r62422, R62422, an osm.org URL…).

client.description: What made the call: geocode-cli, an MCP host, your app.

error.description: The error you got: its code, HTTP status and message.

input.description: The op input you sent (no secrets).

op.description: The op or endpoint, e.g. get_boundary or GET /v1/boundaries/{id}.

query.description: The search text or input that misbehaved.

request_id.description: X-Request-Id of the failing call (or the error body's request_id).

status.description: HTTP status of the failing call.

details.description: What you did, what you expected and what happened.

force.description: File even when similar issues exist.

op.description: The op the failing call used, e.g. get_boundary (same as context.op).

request_id.description: The request_id of the failing call (same as context.request_id).

title.description: What is wrong, in one line.

name: report_issue
title: Report an issue
